I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-random: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is IT ticket #4092.

It comes from Ilse's message in that same channel yesterday (13 Oct) at 11:55. She said the ticket is open to replace the hub in there. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. Dana is a member of #north-random, so this is something she could already see herself.
